lines.note: Bugfixes

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where players could flash behind a wall (either on purpose or by accident) in the new Petricite Grove map

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Chauffeur was snapping allies back to their dead teammates position (We promise this won't happen in teams of 3)

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Nocturne's Guest of Honor would some times ult the player irl (aka their entire screen goes dark)

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where players weren't being granted an additional augment from Tahm Kench's Guest of Honor if augments slots were full

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Hivemind was doing twice as much damage as intended

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where ??? is healing much more than intended

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where receiving Prowler's Claw or Goredrinker from Poppy's Guest of Honor would break Shardholder eligibility

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where the Void Immolation Quest augment was preventing players from purchasing Rabadon's Deathcap

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where magic penetration wasn't being tracked or boosted by Shardholder

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Minionmancer amplified damage was not being applied to Azir's Sand Soldiers (W)

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Double Tap can trigger Power Flower multiples (or consume the entire plant if max leveled)

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed some race conditions that occurred when trying to spam click anvils (Please stop using spam clickers)

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Despoil was not stacking on blinks. They did work on dashes though!

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where players are unable to move while activating Wooglet's stasis when they have the We'll Be Right Back capstone unlocked

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where pools from Morgana's Guest of Honor would sometimes leave invisible pools on other Arenas

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Fixed a bug where Hollow Radiance's Immolate does not trigger
